verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs say you can run variance analysis on the budgeting platform and 'understand and flag the reasons behind identified gaps.' The Analyst Agent is described as monitoring the business and 'uncovering what matters,' with natural-language Q&A over business data. It is unclear whether the platform itself generates the explanation of a variance. The demo instead shows reasons gathered by tagging colleagues in comment threads, so automated root-cause explanation is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automated budget-to-actual or period-over-period variance decomposition and driver attribution, examples of system-generated variance narratives, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
